listings.name: 10 Copy-Paste AI Prompts for Teachers
listings.title: 10 Copy-Paste AI Prompts for Teachers | ChatGPT Time Savers | Free
listings.description:
Ten AI prompts that work on the first try, for the tasks that actually eat your evenings: parent emails, leveled passages, rubrics, quiz questions, and newsletter blurbs.

Copy, paste, change the bracket, done. No account, no signup, no tool required beyond whatever chatbot you already have.

Built and audited by two certified teachers with 20+ combined years in classrooms. If these save you an evening, our full PD sessions are in the store.

listings.name: The One Hard Rule Poster
listings.title: AI Student Privacy Poster | The One Hard Rule | Staff Room Printable | Free
listings.description:
One rule, printed big enough to end the argument: never put student personally identifiable information into a public AI tool. Not a name. Not a detail. Ever.

Print it for the staff room, the copier, or the back of your own door. It covers every tool your staff will ever use, including the ones that do not exist yet.

Built and audited by two certified teachers.

listings.name: AI Tool Safety Checklist
listings.title: AI Tool Safety Checklist for Teachers | Vet Any AI Tool in 5 Minutes | Free
listings.description:
A new AI tool lands in your inbox every week. This is what to check before you or your students touch it: what it does with data, who owns what you type, what it asks for, and the questions worth taking to your district.

One page, five minutes, works on any tool.

Built and audited by two certified teachers.

listings.name: Talking to Parents About AI
listings.title: Talking to Parents About AI | Family Communication Guide for Teachers | Free
listings.description:
Plain answers to the questions families actually ask: is my child using AI, is that cheating, is their data safe, and what is the school doing about it.

Ready to send, ready to say out loud at conferences, written so nobody needs a technology background to follow it.

Built and audited by two certified teachers.

listings.name: AI Readiness Checklist for School Leaders
listings.title: AI Readiness Checklist for School Leaders | Principal Planning Tool | Free
listings.description:
Where your building actually stands on AI, in one honest page: what your staff is already doing, what is written down, what is not, and what to do first.

Built for principals and instructional coaches who need a starting point rather than a strategy deck.

Built and audited by two certified teachers.

listings.name: 20 De-Identification Drills
listings.title: AI Student Privacy Practice | 20 De-Identification Drills | FERPA-Friendly | Free
listings.description:
The one AI skill every teacher needs and nobody practices: getting real help from AI without ever putting a student's identity into it.

Twenty before-and-after prompt makeovers, from parent emails to IEP-adjacent requests to the sneaky no-name prompts that still identify a child. Cover the answer, rewrite it in your head, compare. Ten seconds per prompt by the last page.

Includes the three de-identification moves, the ten-second test, and a printable pocket checklist. Every name is fictional; the unsafe examples exist for practice.

Built and audited by two certified teachers.

listings.name: Kit 1 — AI Foundations & Safety
listings.title: AI Professional Development for Teachers | Complete Staff PD Session | AI Foundations & Safety with Editable Slides, Script & Handouts
listings.description:
Run a complete, professional AI training for your staff THIS MONTH, with no consultant and no prep marathon. This is Session 1 of the AI Foundations series: what AI actually is, what it is good and bad at, and the one student-privacy rule every educator must follow.

Any confident teacher-leader can present it cold. The script is word for word, the 34-slide deck matches it cue for cue, and a live AI mistake during the hands-on lab is a teaching gift rather than a failure.

INCLUDED (9 files): facilitator prep guide (15-minute read) · word-for-word script · 34-slide PowerPoint deck, fully editable, with speaker notes on every slide · participant handout · first-48-hours action sheet · 30-day implementation plan with PLC follow-ups · exit ticket that doubles as PD documentation · admin one-pager · full APA references with every statistic verified against the live source.

RUNNING THIS WITH YOUR WHOLE STAFF? Additional licenses are $10 each, and we accept purchase orders through TpT for Schools.

Built and audited by a husband-and-wife team of certified teachers with 20+ combined years in classrooms.
